references.title: Wise — mobile components
references.author: Wise / Ness Grixti / Ragged Edge
references.group: A. Brand and mobile financial overview
references.apply: the already approved reference shows a brand applied to light surfaces, amounts, and mobile components with breathing room.
references.avoid: copying the green palette, typography, or currency exchange features.

references.title: Apple Wallet — balance and transactions
references.author: Apple
references.group: A. Brand and mobile financial overview
references.apply: balance hierarchy, rounded blocks, soft background, and a grouped list. A direct reference for Apple's visual language.
references.avoid: importing connected bank cards, limits, available credit, or payment rules.
references.status: New candidate in the revised visual selection

references.title: Expenses — iPhone summary and list
references.author: Blue Comet Labs / Expenses
references.group: A. Brand and mobile financial overview
references.apply: a readable main amount, breakdown of inflows and outflows, and records grouped by day. Use the phone interface as the reference.
references.avoid: copying purple, promotional framing, sharing, or the other product's rules.
references.status: New candidate in the revised visual selection

references.title: Dime — overview and spacing
references.author: Rafael Soh / Dime
references.apply: a prominent number, little ornamentation, small icons, and generous list spacing.
references.avoid: copying typography or weekly indicators, or limiting Blubby to Dime's features.
references.status: New candidate in the revised visual selection

references.title: Dime — entering an amount
references.author: Rafael Soh / Dime
references.apply: focused entry with a central amount, restrained actions, and supporting information near the keyboard.
references.avoid: omitting required MVP fields or assuming keyboard behavior or validation has been defined.
references.status: New candidate in the revised visual selection

references.title: Dime — lists and settings
references.author: Rafael Soh / Dime
references.apply: clear groups, consistent alignment, short labels, and recognizable iPhone controls.
references.avoid: copying every option; notifications, widgets, and other features do not become part of the MVP.
references.status: New candidate in the revised visual selection
